meta.name: The Vince Staples Show
meta.description: Kind of famous and sort of rich, rapper and actor Vince Staples navigates the challenges and surprises of everyday life in his hometown of The Beach.

videos.title: Pink House
videos.overview: After getting pulled over for speeding, Vince lands behind bars and meets an aspiring singer, inquisitive cops and a hostile inmate with a grudge.

videos.title: Black Business
videos.overview: When an armed robbery breaks out at the bank where Vince is applying for a small-business loan, he seizes an opportunity to negotiate a lucrative deal.

videos.title: Brown Family
videos.overview: Tensions flare up over mac and cheese at a family reunion. As aunties bicker and hard truths emerge, Vince has a heart-to-heart with Uncle James.

videos.title: Red Door
videos.overview: At a theme park, a mission turns into a misadventure for Vince, who encounters a menacing mascot. Deja gets into a heated argument at the gift shop.

videos.title: White Boy
videos.overview: A run-in with a longtime enemy at Vince's old school escalates into a cat-and-mouse game all over Long Beach.
